title: Kill an evento-server
label: before-g5n16

observations.name: APAC bundles fail over to a healthy server
observations.expected: APAC commands acknowledged again within 60 s of the kill, through another server
observations.expectedBeforeFix: stranded: the bundle redials only the first (dead) address (G2)
observations.observed: no APAC command acknowledged while evento-apac was down

observations.name: APAC bundles fail back to evento-apac once it is healthy again (N16)
observations.expected: every APAC JVM that failed over is attached to evento-apac again, without a restart, within the stability window + jitter (+ one window for gateways)
observations.expectedBeforeFix: no failback: the JVMs stay on evento-eu/evento-am until their next disconnect or a restart (N16); 2.4.6 never failed over, so there is nothing to fail back
observations.observed: no APAC JVM was on another server while evento-apac was down

observations.name: catalog registration under mass reconnect
observations.expected: no duplicate-key errors while bundles re-register (G8 fix)
observations.expectedBeforeFix: 'duplicate key' on core__bundle/component/payload during the reconnect storm (G8)
observations.observed: 0 duplicate-key log lines on the servers

observations.name: in-flight APAC calls at the kill
observations.expected: fail immediately with a typed broker-changed/disconnect error (G4 fix)
observations.expectedBeforeFix: hang until the 30 s request timeout, outcome indeterminate (G4)
observations.observed: 3 gateway command(s) in flight: 3 failed after >= 25 s, 0 failed fast, kinds {timeout=3}; bundle side: 0 BrokerChangedException, 1 RequestTimeoutException

observations.name: I1 after the server returns
observations.expected: every 2xx-acknowledged command has its event in es__events
observations.observed: 0 of 90 acknowledged ops missing; 1 unacknowledged ops were stored anyway

observations.name: I2 after the server returns
observations.expected: one OrderCreated per order; no key stored twice; observer deliveries = 1; payment attempts = 1

observations.name: I4 after the server returns
observations.expected: order_view of each cell database contains only that cell's contexts

observations.name: I5 after the server returns
observations.expected: order_view_global = union of the cells' order_view (same ids, status, item count, context)
observations.observed: 0 missing in global, 0 missing regionally, 0 mismatched

observations.name: I6 after the server returns
observations.expected: read models reach the event store's state within 180 s

observations.name: I7 after the server returns
observations.expected: core__bundle / core__handler / core__consumer list every live bundle, handler and consumer
observations.observed: 0 bundle(s), 0 handler(s), 0 consumer(s) missing; 0 bundle(s) without handler rows

observations.name: no command applied twice (events)
observations.expected: 0 events stored twice: retries carry an idempotency key and are replayed (G5)
observations.expectedBeforeFix: a retry after an indeterminate failure stores the command again (G5, N14)
observations.observed: 0 duplicate event(s): {duplicateOrderCreated=0, duplicateItemsBeyondSent=0, duplicateOrderCompleted=0, duplicatePaymentProcessed=0, idempotencyKeysStoredTwice=0, duplicateObserverDeliveries=0, duplicatePaymentExecutions=0}

observations.name: no payment executed twice (side effects)
observations.expected: 0: the saga's retry carries the derived key of its first attempt and is replayed (G5)
observations.expectedBeforeFix: the saga's retry of an indeterminate ProcessPayment charges again (N14)
observations.note: Residual window, documented: a payment whose event could not be stored (append failed or the server died first) leaves no key behind, so its retry runs the handler again.

invariants.name: no lost events
invariants.expected: every 2xx-acknowledged command has its event in es__events
invariants.observed: 0 of 90 acknowledged ops missing; 1 unacknowledged ops were stored anyway

invariants.name: no duplicate events or side effects
invariants.expected: one OrderCreated per order; no key stored twice; observer deliveries = 1; payment attempts = 1

invariants.name: no aggregate fork
invariants.expected: every story is valid under the aggregate's rules; sequence numbers unique

invariants.name: regional isolation
invariants.expected: order_view of each cell database contains only that cell's contexts

invariants.name: global completeness
invariants.expected: order_view_global = union of the cells' order_view (same ids, status, item count, context)
invariants.observed: 0 missing in global, 0 missing regionally, 0 mismatched

invariants.name: convergence
invariants.expected: read models reach the event store's state within 180 s

invariants.name: catalog matches live bundles
invariants.expected: core__bundle / core__handler / core__consumer list every live bundle, handler and consumer
invariants.observed: 0 bundle(s), 0 handler(s), 0 consumer(s) missing; 0 bundle(s) without handler rows

invariants.name: command latency per region
invariants.expected: recorded as a baseline (p50/p95/p99), not a pass/fail
invariants.observed: n=111 ack=90 failed=21 p50=611ms p95=3847ms p99=30400ms max=30489ms failures={error=18, timeout=3}

timeline.event: load start [EUROPA, AFRICA, AMERICA, SUD_AMERICA, CINA, INDIA, AUSTRALIA_NZ] @4.0/min for 110 s
